items.stem: Which set describes what partners can build with on Glean?

options.text: APIs, MCP-based tools, embedded experiences, agent extensions, and the connector framework.

items.stem: Why is build work described as higher margin for partners?

options.text: Custom agents, connectors, and embedded experiences create reusable IP.
Because build work is always billed at a premium day rate.

items.stem: An agent, in one sentence, is:

options.text: The governed workflow wrapper that packages skills, tools, and knowledge together.
An open protocol for exposing tools to AI applications.
A single tool call that writes to one system.

items.stem: Which build surface brings a proprietary internal source into the knowledge layer?
